A reproducible sweep (tools/translation_bs_drafts.py sweep, plan P01_02_SWEEP: headers become 1-A/1-B/1-C, lambda 8/12/16/24/32/50 x ring weight 50/200/1000) fits every run (17356-17532 stream bytes, at most 17532 of 18428), but every run fails the strict +-1 ring gate (ring max 6-7) and the float-IDCT cross-check (31 steps: the fixed-point decode wraps near the saturated white paper). Size is not the blocker; ring error and the white-paper wrap are. Earlier wording (1022 non-zero trailing bytes, stream cannot grow) was wrong
